# SOP-P3-L4-02 Product changeover - Heat Treat line
Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P3, line P3-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L4-RR01, EQ-P3-L4-HT02, EQ-P3-L4-SB03  
Related documents: MM-P3-L4-RR01-S3, MM-P3-L4-SB03, SB-1019

1. Purpose
   1.1 Define the required steps to perform a product changeover on the Heat Treat line while maintaining part integrity and traceability.

2. Preconditions
   2.1 Production order and new part print available and verified per MM-P3-L4-RR01-S3.  
   2.2 All affected equipment at a complete stop and isolated per lockout procedures in MM-P3-L4-SB03.  
   2.3 Materials staging confirmed against SB-1019.

3. PPE
   3.1 Operators: heat-resistant gloves, safety glasses, hearing protection, and protective footwear.  
   3.2 Maintenance: arc-rated face shield for open furnace access and insulated gloves for handling hot tooling.

4. Changeover sequence
   4.1 Verify current recipe loaded on EQ-P3-L4-HT02 matches incoming product requirements.  
   4.2 Remove and tag outgoing tooling on EQ-P3-L4-RR01 using the traceability label process in MM-P3-L4-RR01-S3.  
   4.3 Install incoming tooling and verify fit by dry-check procedure.  
   4.4 Confirm blast cabinet consumables and lubricant status before startup; the lubricant part number for Heat Treat shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P3-L4-SB03) is CFW-LUB-526.  
   4.5 Energize systems and perform first-part verification. The quench delay maximum for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02) is 20 seconds.  
   4.6 Record first-part measurements and attach inspection tag per SB-1019.

5. Acceptance
   5.1 If first-part inspection meets requirements, commence limited production run and monitor for stability.  
   5.2 If nonconforming, stop line and notify maintenance per MM-P3-L4-SB03.

6. Sign-off
   6.1 Operator completing changeover signs name, employee ID, and timestamp on electronic record.  
   6.2 Supervisor reviews and initials acceptance into production batch record.
